name: PBR
summary: A proposed long-duration balloon successor to EUSO-SPB2 would combine optical and radio views of air showers while maturing technology for future space-based observations.
detection_principle: A shared wide-field Schmidt optical system measures fluorescence and Cherenkov signals, complemented by radio antennas for coincident air-shower observations and neutrino-targeted follow-up.
